models_evaluated: LLM with RAG and prompt engineering
LLM with math scratchpad, RAG, and prompt engineering

links.outcome: ABG interpretation accuracy with vs without RAG grounding
links.effect: Accuracy 78% (39/50) with RAG plus prompt engineering (Method 2) versus 48% (24/50) zero-shot (Method 1); 86% (43/50) with scratchpad added.
links.quote: The LLM-integrated CDSS achieved an accuracy rate of 86% (43/50) [confidence interval (CI) 74%-93%] across a dataset of 50 ABG results when utilizing Method 3, compared to 78% (39/50) [CI 65%-87%] for Method 2 and 48% (24/50) [CI 35%-61%] for Method 1.

links.outcome: LLM calculation errors in ABG interpretation
links.effect: Zero-shot LLM accuracy was 48% (24/50); adding math scratchpad raised accuracy to 86% (43/50), overcoming calculation limitation.
links.quote: The evaluation demonstrates a math scratchpad's utility in ABG interpretation by overcoming LLMs' calculation limitation.

unlisted_practices: Custom math scratchpad (external calculation tool) to offload domain-specific calculations from the LLM

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares deployment prompt strategies (retrieval-augmented generation and calculation scratchpad tooling) against zero-shot prompting on an arterial blood gas interpretation benchmark.

primary.practice: retrieval-augmented generation and math scratchpad prompting
